plan: Given my value of $32, I aim to maximize profit by bidding just above the expected average bids of others. Assuming uniform distribution, others' values average around $24.5. Bidding slightly above this, say $25.6, increases my win chance while ensuring profit if I win. This strategy balances winning probability with potential profit, considering no past round data is available.

Given my value of $6, I should bid less than this to ensure a profit if I win. To maximize profit, I will consider bidding slightly above half my value, around $3. This strategy balances the chance of winning with the potential profit margin, as bidding too high risks paying more than my value.

With a value of $17, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while having a chance to win. Bidding too close to $17 risks a loss if another bidder bids higher. Given no history, I will bid conservatively to ensure the bid is lower than my value but competitive. A bid of $15 maximizes potential profit if I win, while ensuring I don't overpay.
